checks.detail: Commission M6/remaps and the physical tool changer for the mapped tools.
Verify physical tool identity and calibrated T/H and work offsets.
Verify machine travel, workholding and all cutting/approach/link/retract clearances.
Verify spindle 0, direction, attainable speeds and site at-speed behavior.
Verify coolant command behavior and wiring, including off at shutdown.
G95 requires actual spindle 0 speed feedback (spindle.0.speed-in).

limitations: Requested ranges exclude translator initialization and shutdown; they are not measured motion or spindle history.
CSS and its RPM cap do not predict actual spindle speed.
No HAL, INI, live controller or physical clearance checks were performed.
